question.wording: Is this item a security deposit the taxpayer plans to return to the tenant at the end of the lease?

options.label: Yes — a deposit to be returned, not rent
No — rent, or a deposit kept or applied as rent

default.because: Rent received is rent unless a preparer says it is a deposit to be returned

citation.wording: Don’t include a security deposit in your income when you receive it if you plan to return it to your tenant at the end of the lease.
